title: 第21章 内门弟子第22章 擂台战
lines: “青灵宗，外人不得接近。”
许辰刚接近山门，便被负责看守山门的武者拦了下来。
“在下许辰，这是入宗推荐信，和信物！”
许辰被拦住，丝毫不恼，拿出推荐信和令牌，恭敬地说道。
守山武者听到许辰的话后，不敢怠慢，因为只有内门长老和宗主，才有资格推荐弟子入宗。
也就是说，这个看上去年纪不大的少年，身后站着一个至少是内门长老的大人物，这种人，不是他一个外门弟子可以得罪的。
接过许辰递过来的推荐信和令牌，他瞅了一眼，令牌中心镌刻着一个‘芸’字。
苏芸长老！
此人竟是苏芸长老推荐来的。
守山武者眼中难掩惊诧之色。
苏芸，青灵宗，最年轻的内门长老，日后成就不可限量。
“师兄，请进。”
守山武者把推荐信和令牌送还给许辰，态度恭敬的说道。
守山武者态度的巨大转变，令许辰也是颇感意外。
看来苏芸在青灵宗的地位不低啊。
他在心中这般想着。
在守山武者亲自的引领下，许辰走入一座大殿，迎接他的是个老人，气息内敛，仿佛一个普通人，许辰却不敢轻视半分，因为他从老人身上感受到一股强烈的威胁。
许辰把推荐信和令牌交给老人，老人看了一眼，淡淡问道：“姓名，年龄，修为！”
许辰老老实实，依次回答，“许辰，17，凝气境四重。”
“还不错。”
老人给了个中肯的评价。
然后拿出一个本子，勾勾画画几笔。
“现在你就是青灵宗内门弟子，这是你的内门弟子服饰，令牌，住所钥匙。”
老人收起本子，从柜台下拿出一个包裹，交给许辰。
接过包裹，走出大殿，许辰面露笑容，从今天开始，他就是青灵宗弟子了。
与此同时。
苏跃被两人搀扶着登上山。
凡是见到苏跃狼狈模样的弟子，都是一副惊诧之色，因为苏跃仗着自己出身不凡，又有个内门长老的姑姑，在青灵宗内嚣张跋扈，欺负了不少人，鲜有如此狼狈的情况。
感受到周围弟子投来的幸灾乐祸的目光，苏跃气得牙痒痒。
“师兄，我们要不去找苏长老吧，她最疼你了，知道你被人欺负了，一定会替你出头的。”
搀扶苏跃的少年建议道。
苏跃怒道：“这蠢主意也就你能想得出来，要是被小姑知道，我被一个比我还小的人给欺负了，第一个挨揍的一定是我。”
少年被苏跃呵斥，唯唯诺诺不敢出声，搀扶着苏跃走了一段距离，他忽然瞳孔一缩，指着前方一个少年，急促道：“师兄，你快看，那个小子是不是伤你之人？”
循着少年所指的方向看去，苏跃看到了刚从大殿中走出的许辰。
“是他！”
苏跃咬牙切齿。
许辰也是看到了苏跃三人，此刻他心情好，朝三人微微一笑，然后转身离开。
“他，他这是什么意思？挑衅吗？真是欺人太甚！”
苏跃气得脸色铁青。
content_en:
"Qingling Sect, outsiders are not allowed to approach."
As soon as Xu Chen approached the mountain gate, he was stopped by the warrior responsible for guarding the mountain gate.
"My Excellency Xu Chen, this is a letter of recommendation for joining the sect and a token!"
Xu Chen was not annoyed at all when he was stopped. He took out the recommendation letter and token and said respectfully.
After hearing what Xu Chen said, the warriors guarding the mountain did not dare to neglect, because only the elders and sect masters of the inner sect were qualified to recommend disciples to join the sect.
In other words, behind this seemingly young boy, there is a big shot who is at least an elder of the inner sect. This kind of person is not something that an outer sect disciple like him can offend.
Taking the recommendation letter and token handed over by Xu Chen, he took a look and saw the word 'Yun' engraved in the center of the token.
Elder Su Yun!
This person was actually recommended by Elder Su Yun.
The warriors guarding the mountain could not hide the look of surprise in their eyes.
Su Yun, Qingling Sect, the youngest inner sect elder, will achieve limitless achievements in the future.
"Senior brother, please come in."
The mountain guardian warrior returned the recommendation letter and token to Xu Chen and said respectfully.
Xu Chen was also quite surprised by the huge change in the attitude of the warriors guarding the mountain.
It seems that Su Yun's status in Qingling Sect is not low.
He thought so in his heart.
Under the personal guidance of the guardian warrior, Xu Chen walked into a hall. What greeted him was an old man with a restrained aura, as if he were an ordinary person. Xu Chen did not dare to despise him because he felt a strong threat from the old man.
Xu Chen handed the recommendation letter and token to the old man. The old man took a look and asked lightly: "Name, age, cultivation level!"
Xu Chen answered honestly, "Xu Chen, 17, fourth level of Qi Condensation Realm."
"Not bad."
The old man gave a fair evaluation.
Then I took out a notebook and sketched a few strokes.
"Now you are an inner disciple of Qingling Sect. These are your inner disciple clothes, token, and residence key."
The old man put away his notebook, took out a package from under the counter, and handed it to Xu Chen.
After taking the package and walking out of the hall, Xu Chen smiled. From today on, he is a disciple of Qingling Sect.
at the same time.
Su Yue was helped up the mountain by two people.
All the disciples who saw Su Yue's embarrassed appearance were astonished, because Su Yue relied on his extraordinary background and having an aunt who was an inner sect elder. He was arrogant and domineering in the Qingling Sect and bullied many people. He was rarely in such an embarrassing situation.
Feeling the gloating looks from the disciples around him, Su Yue was so angry that his teeth itched.
"Senior brother, why don't we go find Elder Su? She loves you the most. If she knows you are being bullied, she will definitely stand up for you."
The young man supporting Su Yue suggested.
Su Yue said angrily: "You are the only one who can come up with this stupid idea. If my sister-in-law finds out that I was bullied by someone younger than me, I will be the first to be beaten."
The young man was scolded by Su Yue, but he didn't dare to say anything. He helped Su Yue walk a certain distance. His pupils suddenly shrank, he pointed at a young man in front of him, and said hurriedly: "Brother, look quickly, is that boy the one who hurt you?"
Looking in the direction pointed by the young man, Su Yue saw Xu Chen who had just walked out of the hall.
"It's him!"
Su Yue gritted his teeth.
Xu Chen also saw Su Yue and the others. He was in a good mood at the moment, smiled at the three of them, then turned and left.
"He, what does he mean by this? Is he provocative? It's really too much!"
Su Yue's face turned livid with anger.
